import math

CONCURRENCY = 80
MIN_I = 1
MAX_I = 10
LOADS = [40, 400, 900, 0]

def instances_for(load, concurrency, min_i, max_i):
    needed = math.ceil(load / concurrency)
    return max(min_i, min(max_i, needed))

for load in LOADS:
    needed = math.ceil(load / CONCURRENCY)
    n = instances_for(load, CONCURRENCY, MIN_I, MAX_I)
    line = f"load={load} -> instances={n}"
    if needed > MAX_I:
        line += " (max reached)"
    elif needed < MIN_I:
        line += " (min floor)"
    print(line)
